articles.title: Apple has warned iPhone owners in 110 countries about spyware attacks
articles.description: On 13 August, Apple sent out alerts to iPhone users in 110 countries warning of a new wave of attacks involving commercial spyware. The number of potential victims has not been disclosed, nor have the attacks been linked to specific hackers, governments or manufacturers – although in previous warnings of this kind, the company had identified Pegasus, developed by the Israeli NSO Group.
